subject.title: fix(tui): handle live session message updates

question: Should this PR wait for inspectable redacted Gateway-to-running-TUI proof, or may the maintainer narrative proof be accepted for this session-state change?
rationale: The code path looks like the right narrow fix, but the real-behavior proof currently available to reviewers is a narrative statement rather than durable output, logs, recording, or artifact.

options.title: Require inspectable proof
options.body: Attach redacted terminal output, logs, a recording, or a linked artifact showing an external Gateway message appear in an already-running TUI before merge.

options.title: Accept the narrative proof
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally accept the described source-blind live run, but the review record will lack independently inspectable proof.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Keep this PR out of merge queues until proof and any needed base refresh are available.

recommendation.title: Require inspectable proof
recommendation.body: Attach redacted terminal output, logs, a recording, or a linked artifact showing an external Gateway message appear in an already-running TUI before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned on the PR and authored the current rewrite/proof update, so he is the best available owner for the proof sufficiency call.
